messages:
nina.platform: quick flag question — we should formalize a tombstone/expiry policy for cohort overrides. saw a canary accidentally stick around in prod last week.

craig.sre: +1. proposal: server-enforced TTL on transient overrides, default 24h, hard max 7d, console warns if >72h. also emit a "stale-rollout" alert if no change in traffic for 24h.

tom.eng: technical note: TTL must be enforced by the config-service (not only UI). plan: persist expiry timestamp on snapshot metadata and have a background reconciler that auto-reverts expired overrides using the snapshot revert API.

rachel.devexp: UX asks: 1) show expiry countdown on the rollout tile; 2) color change when <1h left; 3) one-click snooze (ops-only) that records reason. also show a tiny human-readable diff on the rollout card.

infra-bot: Heads-up: created INFRA-1223 to add retention tags for snapshots in S3 and set lifecycle rules.

nina.platform: on reverts: prefer revert-to-snapshot rather than ad-hoc edits so we have exact state and audit. snapshot metadata should include checksum, commit, owner, cohort.

tom.eng: sample revert call i'll implement: `curl -X POST https://console.redwood.internal/api/v1/configs/snapshots/revert -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"snapshot_id":"snap-1728-abcd","reason":"ttl-expiry-auto-revert"}'`

craig.sre: telemetry gating suggestions: alert if increase(http_request_errors_total{cohort="canary"}[5m]) / increase(http_requests_total{cohort="canary"}[5m]) > 0.04 for 3m OR p95(latency) for cohort increases >12% vs baseline. also emit non-paging "stale-rollout" after 24h of unchanged traffic.

rachel.devexp: console lint idea: block creating a 100% override with TTL > 1h unless you explicitly check a confirmation box and type a short justification. otherwise too easy to shoot yourself.

nina.platform: ops integration: when auto-revert happens ops-bot should post to #oncall with snapshot id, reason, and a link to the diff. also add an email to rollout owner.

infra-bot: ops-bot integration OK, will add webhook for snapshot events. runbook: /runbooks/cohort-ttl (linked).

tom.eng: actionables: i will 1) add server-side TTL enforcement + background reconciler 2) implement snapshot tagging (checksum/commit/owner) 3) add list API: /api/v1/rollouts?state=active.

rachel.devexp: i'll deliver UX mocks for the countdown, diff, and revert modal by EOD tomorrow.

nina.platform: meeting to review these changes tomorrow 11:00am PT. thanks everyone. :rocket:
